intent: When a bomb chain knocks players out, each victim bursts in a quick gold sparkle, and a chain that takes down five or more players at once floods every screen, spectators included, with a brief golden flash.
accept: A player knocked out by a chain (killer's chain of 2+ bombs) emits a 12-particle gold burst, 0.6s life, 3px size at their position
A non-chain knockout keeps only the existing effect, no gold sparkle
When 5 or more players are knocked out by the same chain in one snapshot, a full-screen golden flash fades over 0.3s for all viewers
Flash never blocks the view for long and does not appear for smaller chains

criteria.text: A player knocked out by a chain (killer's chain of 2+ bombs) emits a 12-particle gold burst, 0.6s life, 3px size at their position
criteria.evidence: diff assets.ts onSnapshot: emit count 12, #ffd54a, life 0.6, size 3 when killer chain >= 2. No kill visible in after/shot-1..3 so not seen, and no test covers it.

criteria.text: A non-chain knockout keeps only the existing effect, no gold sparkle
criteria.evidence: diff: new emit is guarded by killer chain >= 2; the existing 40-particle death burst is untouched.

criteria.text: When 5 or more players are knocked out by the same chain in one snapshot, a full-screen golden flash fades over 0.3s for all viewers
criteria.evidence: diff: chainKills per killer, n>=5 sets flashStart; drawOverlay draws a #ffd54a fillRect with alpha 0.55 fading over 0.3s. Not visible in any after shot; no test.

criteria.text: Flash never blocks the view for long and does not appear for smaller chains
criteria.evidence: diff: 0.3s duration, peak alpha 0.55, only when n>=5 for one killer; reset on new round.

findings: Effect is nearly invisible: after/shot-2 and shot-3 look identical to before apart from normal play. A 12-particle, 0.6s, 3px gold burst sits on top of the existing 40-particle death burst and the existing gold burst for bonus chains (chain>3), so a phone viewer cannot tell it apart. In assets.ts make the chain-kill sparkle larger and distinct, e.g. more particles, bigger size, a ring or star shap

The 5+ victim flash needs 5 kills by one killer in a single snapshot, which almost never happens in the scenario, so it is not seen in the clip. In assets.ts lower the threshold (e.g. 3) or count kills over a short window (~1s) per killer, and lengthen the flash a little so it registers.
Purely cosmetic: nothing changes what players do or decide. Add a gameplay-affecting element in rules.ts or config.ts, e.g. a score bonus or short speed boost for chain kills of 3+, and show it.
No tests cover the new onSnapshot branches (chain sparkle, flash trigger). Add an assets test with a mock fx that asserts the emit and the flash for 5+ and none for smaller chains.
